========================================
Attribute-like macros in declaration specifiers
========================================

__IO uint32_t ISER[1];
__I uint8_t table[16];
__STATIC_INLINE q31_t clip(q31_t x) { return x; }
__ASM uint32_t __get_PSP(void);

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (array_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      size: (number_literal)))
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (array_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      size: (number_literal)))
  (function_definition
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (type_identifier)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (type_identifier)
          declarator: (identifier))))
    body: (compound_statement
      (return_statement
        (identifier))))
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type))))))

========================================
Attribute-like macros around the declarator
========================================

VKAPI_ATTR VkBool32 VKAPI_CALL debugCallback(void *ud);
int WINAPI wWinMain(void *h, void *p, void *c, int s);

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (type_identifier)
    (macro_attribute)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier))))))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    (macro_attribute)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier))))))

========================================
All-caps declarator names stay declarators
========================================

int FOO;
uint32_t ISER[1];
__signed int sig;

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (identifier))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (array_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      size: (number_literal)))
  (declaration
    type: (sized_type_specifier
      type: (primitive_type))
    declarator: (identifier)))
